name: 610 Console
description: LUNA as Bill Putnam Sr.'s 1960 United Recording desk, with a Studer A800 8-track for tracking.
The desk takes the session's first eight audio tracks, in LUNA's order, and follows LUNA live: add, remove, rename or reorder tracks
in LUNA or on the desk and the strips rebuild.
CONSOLE: a VU meter bridge (one per channel, PROGRAM L/R for the master, MONITOR = master fader, ECHO = echo return);
a black doorknob attenuator per channel (the track fader, with an OFF/ON toggle = mute); and a 610 module per channel with only the
controls a 610 had: L·M·R program bus assign (hard pan), L.F. and H.F. shelving switches, MIC/LINE, a LO/OFF/HI gain switch,
the big LEVEL knob and an ECHO send. Each module is a UA 610-A Preamp & EQ in the track's first insert slot; click INSERT 610 to add one.
The ECHO knob builds a stereo Echo bus with UA Capitol Chambers on first use, then sets the send level.
8-TRACK: a Studer A800 with a VU bridge, reels, head block, eight waveform lanes drawn from the tracks' clips, a red LED counter,
REWIND/STOP/PLAY/REC and CUT IN (punch in on the READY tracks, again to punch out and keep rolling). Each channel remote has
SAFE/READY (record arm), REPRO/INPUT (input monitor) and an input picker. TAPE ON puts UA's Studer A800 tape extension on every channel;
only then does the machine colour the sound. Every knob drag is one undo step in LUNA.
Requires LUNA 3.1.1 or later and the UA 610-A plug-in; Capitol Chambers and the Studer A800 are optional.
